page_title: MNT 0-4 REN | Montpellier v Rennes 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+3' Close! Mousa Tamari (Rennes) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
90+2' Montpellier seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Here comes a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo is given a rest as he is replaced by Ayanda Sishuba (Rennes).
87' 0 - 4 Goal! 0:4. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

87' Benjamin Lecomte anticipates the direction of the penalty by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
87' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is going to take the penalty!
87' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
87' Celebrations by Rennes are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
86' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Rennes are awarded a penalty kick!
85' Substitution. Simon Cara (Montpellier) on for Teji Savanier.
84' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Montpellier are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Corner kick. Montpellier will have an opportunity.
82' Habib Beye decides to make a substitution. Ludovic Blas will be replaced by Ismael Kone (Rennes).
81' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
78' Brice Samba pulls off a brilliant save! Andy Delort (Montpellier) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
78' Today's match ends for Andy Delort who will be replaced by Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier).

74' Rennes slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
73' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) replacing Jordan James.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hans Hateboer (Rennes) is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Rouault cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Ludovic Blas puts the ball on a plate for Lorenz Assignon (Rennes), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 0:3.
68' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Brice Samba.
67' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
65' A long pass, executed by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
62' None of the Montpellier players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
61' Montpellier show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Montpellier will take a corner kick.
60' Jean-Louis Gasset prepares a substitution. Jordan Ferri is replaced by Nicolas Pays (Montpellier).
60' That's the end of the game for Wahbi Khazri, who is replaced by Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier).
59' The game is interrupted now, Brice Samba (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

56' 0 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Benjamin Lecomte just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:2.
55' The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.
55' 8:8 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 1:4.
52' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Montpellier.

50' Montpellier show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Montpellier.
49' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Benjamin Lecomte comes off his line to intercept.
46' Habib Beye has decided to substitute Seko Fofana and he is replaced by Mousa Tamari (Rennes).
46' Substitution. Abdoul Bamo Meite is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' Florent Batta blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+4' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
45+2' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45+2' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Montpellier players look gutted.
45+2' Goal! Andy Delort (Montpellier) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' The Montpellier players halt their celebrations as referee Florent Batta makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florent Batta ignores the protests.
38' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

37' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Montpellier are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
35' Florent Batta shows a yellow card to Seko Fofana (Rennes) for a tough tackle.
34' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
31' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Lorenz Assignon finds Seko Fofana (Rennes) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball inside the right post. 0:1.
26' Wonderful movement by Rennes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
24' Corner kicks – 2:3.
21' The goal by Montpellier is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
21' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Florent Batta wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
20' A goal, which was scored by Enzo Tchato (Montpellier), was disallowed due to offside.
18' The foul by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florent Batta.
17' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' CHANCE! Andy Delort (Montpellier) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Rennes is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
14' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) meets a cross and produces a header towards the middle of the net, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
14' The linesman makes the right call and Rennes will have a corner.
14' Rennes are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
13' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
11' Rennes showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
6' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Montpellier.
6' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

6' Rennes show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta was nominated as the referee for this game.
